name: Applying The Bible
overview: Scripture calls believers to actively apply God's truth in their lives by attentively listening and embracing wisdom with a willing heart, as Proverbs 22:17 instructs. True worship, rooted in spirit and truth, honors the Father and is only possible through Jesus, the way, the truth, and the life (John 4:23; John 14:6). The believer’s conduct must reflect their divine calling, living worthily and faithfully, knowing that God will judge according to each person’s deeds (Romans 2:6; Ephesians 4:1). By practicing what has been taught and witnessed in Christ, believers experience the peace of God abiding with them (Philippians 4:9).
